title: Violin and piano as first instruments
summary: Discussion of Willie Humphrey and how most learned violin or piano first.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Because I think Willie Humphrey. The Willie Humphrey family?

Yeah, Willie. First learned on a violin. His daddy, his daddy was a famous clown to play, made a movie out there in what he called Hollywood today, when they had silent pitches. My father knew the family very well.
But he also learned, I think his first instrument was violin.

It could have been, see that was a song of a style like that. It was either piano or violin in those days. Of course you had the brass instrument, but they wanted to take up the brass instrument, you see. But the same thing that was mostly a must, piano and the violin. For learning.
You either chose one of those two and then branched out.
For you to branch out in music, you see. And these kids today don't realize the opportunity they had that we didn't have. They get all that for free. And good teachers and everything.
